title: State-of-the-Nation ML experiments
summary: Coordinated learning state is checkpointed as a group so model, optimizer, training session, RNG, population and cursors move through history atomically.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: A multi-object learning step must not restore only part of its state.
Experiment branches are State-of-the-Nation checkpoint pointers.
Random state and optimizer/session state are part of reproducible continuation when they affect the next step.
procedure: Register every driveable participant before taking the run initial checkpoint.
Take a checkpoint immediately before the learning event.
On success checkpoint the coherent new world; on failure restore the before-checkpoint.
Preserve an alternate future when rolling back for a new policy/hypothesis.

provenance.claim: MLTrainingRun coordinates model, optimizer and training session through MLExperiment/State-of-the-Nation.
Coordinated rollback and roll-forward across participants.
